d:
Watch Thoovaanam from Romeo Juliet in Vishal Dadlani & Sunitha Sarathy's voice. Thamarai pens lyrics for this song that is all about how the world changes upside down when someone falls in love.
Song Name - Thoovaanam
Movie - Romeo Juliet
Singer - Vishal Dadlani & Sunitha Sarathy
Music - D. Imman
Lyrics - Thamarai
Director - Lakshman
Starring - Jayam Ravi, Hansika Motwani
